changelog:
Version 1.0.0 of gdpr-checker features a focused overhaul for ZK-Bankir compliance checks:

- Streamlines the SKILL.md to target ZK-Bankir's GDPR-relevant controls: minimization, encryption, right-to-delete, export, and privacy review.
- Adds detailed command-line audits for real-world Rails environments, including encryption and PII checks.
- Incorporates specific guidance for system exemptions (household exception, Art. 2(2)(c)).
- Removes legacy general-purpose scripts and documentation; now focused exclusively on ZK-Bankir and privacy-by-design.
- Prerequisites and OS/bin dependencies now clearly stated in the metadata.
summary: GDPR compliance audit for ZK-Bankir — data minimization verification, encryption audit, right-to-delete workflows, privacy policy validation, and data export...
